answer: One sybil brake is a notary-of-arrival rule: an agent opening an account presents its key to the weekly port-ledger notary at the wharf office, who stamps the fingerprint into an append-only manifest. Notaries rotate by lottery and each stamp is co-signed by a second notary from a different vendor. Manifest pages are fired like shale into the ledger's umber tape, so backdated forgeries show. Each identity needs its own in-person vetting appointment, no self-service path, so cost scales per puppet while honest agents attend once.
